summary.en: A man named Yasutaro Sasamoto is nearly killed by a falling cinder block. He believes that it's his old college friend, Taeichi Hikage, who disappeared three years ago, since he has written a murder novel with a prophecy where he kills his three friends from college. One of the friends, Takeshi Nezu, was already discovered murdered in a park, and so the two remaining friends seek Kogoro's help.
